claims.claim_text: As of the Democratic Party's 2000 platform, eight of the ten hottest years ever recorded had occurred during the preceding ten years.
Scientists predict that global warming is likely to submerge much of Florida and Louisiana.
Scientists predict that global warming is likely to bring more record floods, droughts, heat waves and wildfires.
Scientists predict that global warming is likely to spread diseases and pests to new areas.
Scientists predict that global warming is likely to cause crop failures and famines.
Scientists predict that global warming is likely to bring melting glaciers, stronger storms and rising seas.
The Democratic Party's 2000 platform attributes the predicted flooding, extreme weather, disease spread, crop failures, glacier melting and rising seas from global warming to human actions.
The predicted harmful effects of human-caused global warming can be prevented only through a new set of human actions involving major choices and new thinking.
Democrats propose helping Americans afford the high-performing, fuel-efficient and emissions-compliant cars developed through the Partnership for a New Generation of Vehicles.
Democrats commit to improving fuel economy in ways that preserve and create jobs for American workers and deliver products consumers want to buy.
Democrats call on the oil industry to join Democrats in producing much cleaner fuels that allow automotive environmental equipment to achieve the maximum possible emissions reductions.
